name: tattoo-girl-bavarian-dress
image_purpose: Cultural fashion post and lifestyle portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-realistic lifestyle portrait of an approved adult woman wearing a traditional Bavarian dirndl in a domestic interior.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with long dark-brown slightly wavy hair, blue eyes, fair skin, a gentle smile, and visible line-art tattoos on both arms. She wears the exact royal-blue floral dirndl with white lace blouse, white satin lacing, silver floral hooks, cameo pendant, bracelets, and rings from the reference, holding the white ribbons at chest level while adjusting the bodice.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical medium portrait from head to below the waist, subject centered and looking toward camera. Include the grey glass-front china cabinet with bottles and glassware, white beadboard ceiling, natural wood door frame, landscape calendar, and black metal light fixture. Preserve the domestic kitchen or dining-room context.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural window light with gentle ambient interior fill, realistic shadows under the chin and around the cabinet, warm rustic domestic atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm portrait lens, vertical framing, sharp but natural focus, realistic skin pores and fabric weave, subtle film grain, restrained saturation, no artificial smoothing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A hyper-realistic vertical portrait of one approved adult woman with long dark-brown loose waves, blue eyes, fair skin, a gentle smile, and delicate line-art tattoos on both arms in a rustic domestic kitchen or dining room. She wears the exact royal-blue floral Bavarian dirndl and white lace blouse from the reference, with white satin ribbons, silver floral hooks, a cameo pendant, bracelets, and rings, holding the white ribbons at chest level while adjusting the fit. Behind her are a grey glass-front china cabinet with bottles and glassware, a white beadboard ceiling, a natural wood door frame, a landscape calendar, and a black metal light fixture. Soft natural light, realistic fabric and skin texture, 50mm portrait look, subtle film grain, and warm authentic atmosphere.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, invented text, watermark, low resolution, blur
